tagline: Turning Market Data Into Market Intelligence.

events.title: Salesforce up 3.2% after announcing Listen Labs acquisition
events.summary: Salesforce Inc. shares rose 3.2% after the company announced its acquisition of Listen Labs, an AI-powered customer research and human simulation platform. This acquisition will enhance Salesforce's customer understanding capabilities, integrating with its Marketing Cloud, Service Cloud, and broader AI portfolio. Listen Labs' technology uses AI agents to conduct and synthesize customer research rapidly, drawing from a global network of participants and utilizing digital twins for simulated customer responses.

articles.headline: Salesforce up 3.2% after announcing Listen Labs acquisition

events.title: $67 billion NextEra-Dominion merger could raise U.S. electricity prices, lawmakers say
events.summary: Democratic lawmakers are expressing concerns that the proposed $67 billion merger between NextEra Energy and Dominion Energy could lead to higher electricity prices and reduced competition. In a letter to FERC, they urged close scrutiny of the deal, fearing the enlarged company would gain excessive market power, potentially raising costs for consumers and hindering grid upgrades. The lawmakers also questioned the companies' promises of bill credits, citing past instances where such savings failed to materialize after mergers.

articles.headline: $67 billion NextEra-Dominion merger could raise U.S. electricity prices, lawmakers say

events.title: Fox Corporation stock gains 1.23 percent in trading
events.summary: Fox Corporation (FOXA) stock increased by 1.23% to EUR 55.78 at Lang & Schwarz. This gain follows strong fiscal 2026 results, with revenue up 5% to USD 17.13 billion, despite regulatory delays for its planned acquisition of Roku. Analysts have set price targets for Fox Class A shares ranging from USD 82.00 to USD 95.00.

articles.headline: Fox Corporation stock gains 1.23 percent in trading

events.title: Even hands-free phone use will be barred while driving on the job under Essential Utilities (WTRG)'s merger plans.
events.summary: Essential Utilities (WTRG) is implementing new employee policies as part of its merger integration with American Water, including a ban on cell phone use while driving on the job, even with hands-free devices, effective on Day 1 of the combined organization. The company also plans to phase out its personal-use company vehicle program by December 31, 2028. The merger is expected to close by the end of the first quarter of 2027, with further organizational role selections and system alignments continuing post-closing.

articles.headline: Even hands-free phone use will be barred while driving on the job under Essential Utilities (WTRG)'s merger plans.

events.title: Hormel Acquires Chicken Processor for $1B
events.summary: Hormel Foods Corp. announced its acquisition of Brakebush Brothers LLC, a family-owned chicken processor, for $1.055 billion. This move strengthens Hormel's position in the value-added chicken and foodservice sectors. Brakebush, with $1.2 billion in net sales, five production facilities, and two R&D labs, will help Hormel better serve national and regional operators with high-quality chicken products.

articles.headline: Hormel Acquires Chicken Processor for $1B

events.title: Conagra Brands, Inc (CAG) Q1 2027 Earnings Call Transcript
events.summary: Conagra Brands discussed its Q1 FY27 earnings, reaffirming its full-year outlook despite a beat in Q1 driven by SG&A timing, Ardent Mills benefit, lower inflation, and a tariff refund. The company outlined its strategy for managing higher transportation inflation, deleveraging to a 3x target, and optimizing its product portfolio through SKU simplification and increased A&P spending. Conagra emphasized a prudent approach to elasticity assumptions and a focus on core platforms and brand building.

articles.headline: Conagra Brands, Inc (CAG) Q1 2027 Earnings Call Transcript

events.title: Nasdaq Gains Over 100 Points; Jabil Posts Upbeat Earnings
events.summary: U.S. stocks saw broad gains, with the Nasdaq Composite climbing over 100 points, driven by strong performance in the information technology sector. Jabil Inc. reported better-than-expected fourth-quarter earnings and provided an optimistic outlook for FY2027, beating analyst estimates for both EPS and sales. Several other equities experienced significant movements, with NewGenIvf Group, Connect Biopharma Holdings, and Neo-Concept International Group seeing large gains, while Darkiris Inc., Decent Holding Inc., and Rafael Holdings Inc. declined.

articles.headline: Nasdaq Gains Over 100 Points; Jabil Posts Upbeat Earnings

events.title: Copart stock trades at EUR 23.91 after fiscal results
events.summary: Copart stock was trading at EUR 23.91 at Lang & Schwarz, down 0.08 percent, following its fiscal 2026 results. The company reported a 0.4% rise in revenue to USD 4.7 billion for fiscal 2026, but net income and diluted EPS declined. Copart also announced the acquisition of ACV Auctions for USD 1.9 billion to expand its digital vehicle remarketing reach, a move expected to be earnings neutral in the first year and accretive in fiscal 2028.

articles.headline: Copart stock trades at EUR 23.91 after fiscal results

events.title: W.R. Berkley stock reports a quarterly earnings beat
events.summary: W.R. Berkley stock reported a quarterly earnings beat for Q2 2026, with operating EPS of USD 1.27 surpassing the USD 1.08 consensus and revenue reaching USD 3.72 billion against a USD 3.28 billion consensus. Despite the strong performance, Zacks Research cut its Q4 2026 EPS forecast, indicating more cautious estimates moving forward. The company has also declared a quarterly dividend and is scheduled to release its Q3 2026 earnings on October 19, 2026.

articles.headline: W.R. Berkley stock reports a quarterly earnings beat

events.title: Norfolk Southern stock faces a longer merger review timeline
events.summary: Norfolk Southern (NSC) faces an extended merger review timeline after the Surface Transportation Board (STB) allowed the Union Pacific combination to proceed to a fuller review. While the decision keeps the transaction alive, it does not guarantee approval, with comments due in November 2026 and responses by February 2027, pushing expected completion into the second half of 2027. Despite Q2 2026 revenue of $3.46 billion and diluted EPS of $3.26, the company faces headwinds from higher fuel costs and its stock trades below its yearly high, with analysts holding a "Hold" consensus.

articles.headline: Norfolk Southern stock faces a longer merger review timeline

events.title: ADP National Employment Report: Private-Sector Employment Increased by 90,000 Jobs in September
events.summary: Private-sector employment in the U.S. saw an increase of 90,000 jobs in September, rebounding after a three-month slowdown, according to the ADP National Employment Report. This growth was notably driven by the education and health care and leisure and hospitality sectors, while financial activities and professional and business services showed weakness. Base pay for private-sector workers rose by 3.2%, and gross pay increased by 4.7% year over year, with job-changers experiencing higher pay growth than job-stayers.

articles.headline: ADP National Employment Report: Private-Sector Employment Increased by 90,000 Jobs in September

events.title: Premarket movers: Micron; Boeing rises, Moderna slides
events.summary: U.S. stock index futures were largely flat on Wednesday as investors awaited key inflation data and Micron's earnings. Boeing surged after securing a major contract for the Navy's F/A-XX fighter, while Moderna slid following a downgrade from Citi. Concentrix plunged after disappointing revenue guidance, and Trulieve Cannabis also fell despite a new licensing agreement.

articles.headline: Premarket movers: Micron; Boeing rises, Moderna slides

events.title: IPFXU 8-K Filings - Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VI Units SEC 8-K
events.summary: This article provides a list of recent 8-K filings by Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VI Units (IPFXU), detailing material events reported to the SEC. Key filings include announcements regarding its SPAC merger with Quantum Space, valued at approximately $1.2 billion, the separate trading of its Class A ordinary shares and warrants, and the completion of its $253 million SPAC IPO. The filings also provide financial details and expected timelines for these corporate actions.

articles.headline: IPFXU 8-K Filings - Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VI Units SEC 8-K

events.title: US Stock Futures Hold Steady Ahead of PCE Data, Micron Earnings
events.summary: US stock-index futures were stable ahead of Wednesday's market open as investors anticipated the release of the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge, the PCE data. Additionally, earnings reports from Micron Technology Inc. are expected to influence market sentiment. Futures for the S&P 500 Index showed little change, while Nasdaq 100 Index contracts experienced a slight decline.

articles.headline: US Stock Futures Hold Steady Ahead of PCE Data, Micron Earnings

events.title: Marathon Oil stock joined ConocoPhillips in a USD 22.5 billion deal
events.summary: Marathon Oil Corporation was acquired by ConocoPhillips in a USD 22.5 billion deal completed in November 2024, ending its run as an independent public company. The acquisition integrated Marathon Oil's exploration and production assets into ConocoPhillips' larger portfolio. Investors are advised to differentiate Marathon Oil (MRO) from Marathon Petroleum (MPC) due to a 2011 corporate split that created two distinct energy companies.

articles.headline: Marathon Oil stock joined ConocoPhillips in a USD 22.5 billion deal

events.title: Exascale Labs Debuts on Nasdaq After Completing SPAC Merger
events.summary: Exascale Labs Holdings Inc. (XLAB) began trading on Nasdaq after completing its SPAC merger with D. Boral ARC Acquisition I Corp. The company, which provides a software-defined GPU compute platform and AI infrastructure services, faces financial challenges including widening losses and an accumulated deficit, exacerbated by significant redemptions from pre-merger shareholders. Despite its asset-light model and growing customer base, the company has not yet generated revenue from its modular data center and related offerings, and faces strong competition from larger cloud and AI infrastructure providers.

articles.headline: Exascale Labs Debuts on Nasdaq After Completing SPAC Merger

events.title: VinFast Auto (VFS), What Is Behind The Fresh Attention?
events.summary: VinFast Auto (VFS) is attracting new attention following a leadership change, with founder Pham Nhat Vuong's son appointed global CEO, and a strategic shift towards an asset-light model. Despite being presented as 48% undervalued by analysts at $6.05 per share, the company's stock has declined, and it faces significant challenges such as heavy cash burn and limited brand strength. The market also shows caution, trading VinFast at a P/S ratio of 2x, significantly higher than the US Auto industry average of 0.6x, indicating potential valuation risk.

articles.headline: VinFast Auto (VFS), What Is Behind The Fresh Attention?

events.title: Ford's CEO urges caution on Chinese automakers, says Europe is 'too late'
events.summary: Ford CEO Jim Farley has warned the US to be cautious about Chinese automakers entering the American market, citing Europe as a cautionary example where Chinese imports have rapidly gained market share. Farley emphasized that while Ford will partner with Chinese companies for capital efficiency and expertise, they will also compete directly. He highlighted concerns from US officials about Ford's collaborations with Chinese firms and the broader impact of China's growing automotive export industry on global markets.

articles.headline: Ford's CEO urges caution on Chinese automakers, says Europe is 'too late'

events.title: House Targets Hyperliquid in Insider Trading Probe, Cites $1.1B Crypto Short Before Trump Tariffs
events.summary: The House Oversight Committee has expanded its insider trading investigation to include Hyperliquid Labs, Crypto.com, and Aristotle Exchange, focusing on a $1.1 billion crypto short position opened on Hyperliquid before former President Trump announced new tariffs on China. The probe questions Hyperliquid's identity verification processes and its ability to detect suspicious trading activities. This inquiry follows a previous investigation into Polymarket and Kalshi, and concerns a trader who profited over $150 million from the short position.

articles.headline: House Targets Hyperliquid in Insider Trading Probe, Cites $1.1B Crypto Short Before Trump Tariffs

events.title: Disney lays off a few hundred more employees
events.summary: The Walt Disney Co. is conducting another round of layoffs, affecting a few hundred employees primarily in human resources and information technology divisions. This follows previous job cuts earlier in the year, as the company continues to evaluate reductions in labor and administrative expenses under CEO Josh D’Amaro. Disney had approximately 231,000 employees globally at the end of fiscal 2025.

articles.headline: Disney lays off a few hundred more employees
